internal.title: Incident Report: Cart Service High Error Rate Due to Dependency Unreachable
internal.body:
At 11:28 UTC on 2026-11-08, the cart service triggered a high error rate alert (25%) and elevated latency (0.12s p95). Investigation identified that the root cause was an unreachable dependency, Valkey, causing failures in adding items to the cart. CPU and memory metrics were normal, ruling out resource exhaustion. The issue was mitigated by disabling the cartFailure flag at 11:48 UTC, which restored service error rates to normal levels (0.2%).

Timeline:
- 11:28:51 Alert received for high error rate
- 11:48:37 Diagnosis confirmed dependency unreachable
- 11:48:44 Flag disabled after approval
- 11:48:44 Recovery verified with normalized error rates

Actions taken included flag disablement to bypass the faulty dependency, restoring service functionality promptly.
